reason_for_import.trigger: audit-all reported BLOCKED_MISSING_SOURCE for thunderwave_cave with blocker 'BLOCKED/MISSING_ITEM: static_cave: ammo_gravelerock' after promotion of the dungeon
why_this_is_a_source_not_an_invention: The item exists in the canonical PMDO base asset dump (audinowho/DumpAsset) at the exact pinned commit already tracked by the project (see tools/dungeon_builder/scope_registry.py:17 PMDODUMP_COMMIT=21ec4abdddf4f705c6e75a0635358d597c884f8c).
The DumpAsset submodule of PMDODump@21ec4abd points to DumpAsset@d74394dc662612d6655a4f820553adca1bbcde08.
Data/Item/ammo_gravelerock.json in that pinned tree is byte-for-byte the canonical asset audinowho publishes for RogueEssence 0.8.12.0.
The item is not fabricated; the repo simply did not have this specific file yet — every other item referenced by the thunderwave_cave item table already existed in Data/Item.

adaptation_for_this_repo.what_changed: The single-string field "Version" was rewritten from "0.8.12.0" to "0.8.9.0" so it aligns with the 238 other Data/Item/*.json files in the repo, which all declare Version 0.8.9.0. All other bytes (Object.*, Name, Desc, Sprite, Icon, UsageType, MaxStack, Price, actions, effects, etc.) are untouched.
adaptation_for_this_repo.why_this_is_semantically_safe: The Object payload is schema-identical to the existing 0.8.9.0 Data/Item files (verified by diffing the keyset against Data/Item/ammo_iron_thorn.json — 0 keys added, 0 keys removed). The Version string is a serializer marker used by RogueEssence for forward migration; the payload deserializes to the same in-memory ItemData either way at 0.8.9.x runtime.
adaptation_for_this_repo.utf8_bom: Added the UTF-8 BOM prefix to match the repository convention for Data/Item files.

index_registration.action: inserted a single ItemEntrySummary for ammo_gravelerock at the alphabetical position between ammo_geo_pebble and ammo_iron_thorn
index_registration.assembly_pinned_to: 0.8.9.0 (same as every other index.idx entry — matches the local runtime, upstream declares 0.8.12.0)

verification.regression_tests: tests/test_canonical_production_gate.py + tests/test_dungeon_builder.py both green (181 tests total, 0 failures, 2 skipped)

policy_alignment: The project's own PMDODump pin (scope_registry.py) is the authority followed here.
No item property was invented; the payload is exactly what audinowho published in the pinned tree.
Only the Version marker was rewritten to keep serializer consistency with the local runtime; this is documented above and is reversible.
